parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const fail=(statusCode,error)=>[{json:{ok:false,statusCode,error}}];try{const a=$json.headers?.authorization??'',[h,p,s,x]=a.startsWith('Bearer ')?a.slice(7).split('.'):[],secret=$env.JWT_SECRET;if(!secret||!h||!p||!s||x)throw new Error();const ex=crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(`${h}.${p}`).digest('base64url'),l=Buffer.from(s),r=Buffer.from(ex);if(l.length!==r.length||!crypto.timingSafeEqual(l,r))throw new Error();const payload=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(p,'base64url').toString());if(!payload.exp||payload.exp<=Date.now()/1000)throw new Error();const role=String(payload.rol??'').toUpperCase(),perms=(payload.permisos??[]).map(v=>String(v).toLowerCase());if(role!=='SUPERADMIN'&&!perms.includes('parqueadero.gestionar'))return fail(403,'No tiene permisos.');const body=$json.body??{},authorizationId=Number(body.authorizationId),panelUserId=Number(payload.uid??payload.sub),useTemporary=body.useTemporary===true,temporaryPlate=String(body.temporaryPlate??'').trim().toUpperCase(),temporaryVehicleType=String(body.temporaryVehicleType??'').toUpperCase();if(!Number.isInteger(authorizationId)||authorizationId<=0)return fail(400,'Seleccione un ticket válido.');if(!Number.isInteger(panelUserId)||panelUserId<=0)return fail(401,'La sesión no identifica al usuario del panel.');if(useTemporary&&(!/^[A-Z0-9-]{5,15}$/.test(temporaryPlate)||!['AUTO','MOTO'].includes(temporaryVehicleType)))return fail(400,'Ingrese la placa y el tipo del vehículo temporal.');return[{json:{ok:true,authorizationId,panelUserId,useTemporary,temporaryPlate,temporaryVehicleType}}];}catch{return fail(401,'Sesión inválida.');}
